## Slider Overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/slider-overview/>

Slider supports for image slides, also allows you to add slider content and links. There are various options available for sliders that you can manage according to your need. ( Available in **Spacious Pro** )

- Slider Status
- Slider Settings like:
a. Slider Transition Effect
b. Slider Transition Delay Time
c. Slider Length Time
d. Add Number of Slides
- Make the slider image link to the respective page
- Enable next/prev option
- Enable progress bar
- Display slides in random orde r
- Change the position of slider content

---

## How to Change Position of Slider Content?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-position-of-slider-content/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To change the slider content position, follow the steps listed below:

- Go to** Appearance -> Customizer -> Slider**.
- Scroll to locate the **Slider Content #1**.
- Choose the option from **Slider Text Position**.
- Click on **Publish**.

**You can select the slider text position individually for all the slides that you have added on your site.**

---

## How to Make Slider Images Linked to Respective Links?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-make-slider-images-linked-to-respective-links/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

If you want to make the Slider images to link back to respective links then, all you need to do is follow the steps listed below:

- Go to** Appearance -> Customizer -> Slider**.
- Scroll to locate the **Slider Settings**
- Put a checkmark on **Check to make the slider images link back to respective links**.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Change the Number of Slides in the Slider?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-number-of-slides-in-the-slider/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

If you want to add more number of slides in the slider, follow the steps listed below:

- Go to** Appearance -> Customizing -> Slider**.
- Scroll to locate the **Slider Settings.**
- Add the number of slides in **Number of slides. Enter the number of slides you want then click save.**
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Change Slider Settings?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-slider-settings/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

In Slider Settings Option you can manage slider configuration like **Transition Effect**, **Transition delay time**, **Transition length time**

- Go to** Appearance -> Customizing -> Slider**.
- Scroll to Locate the **Slider Settings.**

- **Slider Transition Effect: **Select the transition effect from the drop-down list you want to display for slides and click on Publish.
- **Slider Transition Delay Time: **You can add the delay time for slides when the transition effect will start. The value is defined in seconds. Just add the number and click on Publish.
- **Slider Transition Length Time**: You can add the length time for slides, up to which the slides will display. The value is defined in seconds. Just add the number and click on Publish.

## How to Show Slider on Specific Pages?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-show-slider-on-specific-pages/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

To display slider on front page, blog page or on all pages, all you need to do is:

- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Display Slider?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-display-slider/>

This theme supports home page sider. To use it, follow the steps below:

- From your Dashboard, go to **Appearance > Customize > Slider**
- To activate the slider, check the **Check to activate slider **checkbox.
- Upload the image for the first **slider content #1.** Similarly, add the corresponding slider title, slider description, and redirect link. You can link to a link within your site or outside of your site.
- Repeat the above steps for other slides.
- Now click on **publish.** That’s it, open your homepage and it should be there.
